name: procore-open-items-review
description: Reviews the Procore items actually waiting on your workflow response — change risks, subcontractor invoices and commitment change orders — and publishes the findings to a live dashboard. Filters out everything you are only on distribution for, re-derives the AIA math on pay applications, reads the attached support without downloading it, and lets you respond from the dashboard without opening Procore. Skill version 18 — 2026-08-26.
